subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): failed raw channel sends report success

question: Should the legacy public raw channel adapter begin rejecting `{ ok: false }` results now, before the next Plugin SDK major release?
rationale: The implementation fixes incorrect delivery accounting and matches current documentation, but changing a shipped public adapter from resolved failure objects to rejected promises can alter existing third-party plugin control flow.

options.title: Approve rejection semantics
options.body: Merge the current patch and treat rejected failed sends as the documented compatibility behavior for the legacy adapter.

options.title: Add an opt-in transition
options.body: Keep resolved failure objects by default and introduce an explicit strict adapter or option, at the cost of another temporary public compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer to the next major
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until the legacy raw result contract can be removed or changed at a major-version boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve rejection semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the current patch and treat rejected failed sends as the documented compatibility behavior for the legacy adapter.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns timing and compatibility policy for a shipped Plugin SDK surface rather than a remaining mechanical code defect.
